build.script:
#!/bin/zsh -l
set -e

# $1 = dossier du .tex (ex: examples)
# $2 = chemin complet du .tex (ex: examples/tkz-elements-demo_1.tex)

cd "$1" || exit 1
mkdir -p build

/Library/TeX/texbin/lualatex \
  -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error -shell-escape -synctex=1 \
  -output-directory=build "$2"

run.script:
#!/bin/zsh -l
set -e

# $1 = dossier du .tex
# $2 = chemin complet du .tex

cd "$1" || exit 1
name="$(basename "${2%.*}")"

# Ouvre directement le PDF compilé
open -a Skim "build/$name.pdf"
